ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute is about the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged when the driver ended the trip as a rider no-show. The fee stands and is not refunded to the rider; the driver is compensated SGD 3.20 out of it.

WHY THE CHARGE STANDS. On the platform's own telemetry the driver met the waiting requirement. His trace (EV-GPS-00214) places him at the ION Orchard PHV bay with 40 good-quality fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius fixed for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, in two holds: 18:44:45-18:47:35 (170 seconds) and 18:49:35-18:52:40 (185 seconds). You are right, madam, that the car never sat still for five uninterrupted minutes — the longest single hold is 185 seconds. But POL-NS-06(i) permits the two in-geofence spells to be added together where the driver never went more than 300 m from the pin AND a bus-lane / no-stopping restriction covering the pickup road was in force. Both conditions hold: his furthest point on the loop was 179 m (inside the 300 m leash), and the LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-00214-01 (type KERB_RESTRICTION, Orchard Road and Orchard Turn 17:00-20:00, geometry over the pickup point, window covering the whole wait) is present and populated. The effective dwell is therefore 355 seconds, 55 seconds clear of the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the full-refund route in POL-NS-06 is not triggered. The driver's chat message at 18:47:50 ('the marshal make me move, bus lane until 8pm, i go one round and come back same place ah') is corroborated by the trace: he was complying with an enforced bus lane, not abandoning the pickup. The 15-second gap between the 18:44:30 'arrived' marker and the first in-geofence fix does not defeat the charge — POL-NS-05 treats an early marker as harmless where the corrected dwell still meets the minimum, and here it does.

The rider's coordinating message ('ok coming down now', 18:46:20) did not go unanswered: the driver replied at 18:47:50, 90 seconds later, inside the 120-second limit, so POL-NS-04 does not apply. Independently, the rider's own device sat between 691 m and 717 m from the pickup pin for the entire window (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), so she was not at the pickup point when the driver cancelled.

The amount is correct: the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee is SGD 4.00, matching the fare ledger, so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

WHY THE DRIVER IS PAID. POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 applies: 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee is SGD 3.20, with the residual SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming guard does not bite — 2 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days is below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by 118 completed trips is 0.017, far below 0.08 — so compensation is paid and no escalation arises. On a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the amount_sgd field carries the same SGD 3.20 figure; the rider's own charge is unchanged. No profile field outside those the policy permits has been used to reach this outcome, and no clause in this case generates a referral.
